provider: bangumi.tv AList/OpenList index (the live community list)

free_tier.stated: a free community post listing public AList/OpenList sites and, for many of them, the WebDAV guest credential in plaintext

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; it is a list

retention.stated: maintained; the post read on 2026-10-22 is the current revision and a maintainer prunes dead entries

egress.terms: no egress; it is a page

tooling: a flat forum page at /m/topic/... that needs no login; the read broker returns the whole post body
chaining: the highest-yield discovery input measured, and the one whose curation hides churn rather than showing it

limits.value: a maintainer prunes dead entries, so a survivor count from this list measures the maintainer's diligence and not the population's survival

reliability_note: 20 of the 28 real hostnames on the page answered with a mount list, which is selection and not longevity: a pruned list cannot show you what died.

evidence.proved: the post lists public AList/OpenList sites with a WebDAV credential beside most of them, and its own preamble states that AList was sold and recommends OpenList instead
31 hostname-shaped strings were extracted, of which 3 are not instances (ssl, www, www.kdocs.cn), leaving 28; 26 answered HTTP and 20 returned a non-empty mount list

notes: The one live index worth automating against. It also carries the WebDAV credential next to each site, which is how the WebDAV read path was testable without an account. Of 31 hostname-shaped strings extracted from it, 3 are not instances (ssl, www, www.kdocs.cn), leaving 28, of which 26 answered HTTP and 20 listed mounts.
binding_note: The list is current by construction, so it is the right discovery input and the wrong decay measurement; the constraint is on what the list can prove.
